Two afternoon sessions at [RaukR 2026](https://nbisweden.github.io/raukr-2026/) on writing and
publishing with **Quarto**. You already write R and have used R Markdown or Quarto before. These
sessions show how Quarto works as a *system* and how to go from a single document to a whole project
you can publish.

## Program

| Day | Session | Slides | Lab |
|-----|---------|--------|-----|
| **Mon 10 Aug** | Introduction to Quarto: one document (authoring, layout, and modern output formats, including Typst) | [Slides](slides/quarto/index.qmd) | [Lab](labs/quarto/index.qmd) |
| **Tue 11 Aug** | Quarto projects — beyond one file: websites, configuration, publishing, practical techniques | [Slides](slides/quarto-projects/index.qmd) | [Lab](labs/quarto-projects/index.qmd) |

Each session has **two parts with a break**, and each part ends with hands-on work.

## Before you arrive

See **[Setup](setup.qmd)** for what to install (R ≥ 4.5, Quarto ≥ 1.9, and nine R packages).
